title: The Map Swelled
treatment: A drafting-pen nib called NIB, the study's deep-learning tracer, draws glacier lakes on glowing Landsat tiles while the study's checker ticks its lines in persimmon pencil; our newsroom hand in a pine-green cuff counts the authors' open map and finds Alaska's lakes swelled more than they multiplied; THE CASE FOR YES is drawn at two real glacier fronts at first light; then a nickel rail of three spring scales (the team's machine learning models) weighs lake about 11, climate about 43, shape about 46, and the release card's empty WHY? tab hangs from the card's own clip as an empty pan.

palette.mood: a bright lamplit survey room: careful, amber, a little wondrous; first light outdoors
palette.divergence: 11-27 an outdoor green-slate storm with lemon lightning and brass; 11-26 celadon and orchid under a bone lightbox; 11-25 bone noon snow and railway amber; 11-24 olive tundra and vermilion pins; 11-23 apricot-plum twilight and scarlet. This film: warm umber room, amber-cream vellum, three role inks (ultramarine 232 lines, persimmon 20 hairlines, pine 143 stamps), turquoise lakes, nickel. Honest overlaps: 11-26 also lit an interior from a glowing surface (a clinical bone lightbox; here an amber vellum table plus a lamp key from top left); persimmon sits about 9 degrees from 11-24's vermilion, kept to hairline strokes; the brass streak is broken by nickel. Rock-flour turquoise shares 11-27's green-slate hue family but only as small, high-chroma lake shapes against amber vellum, never as an ambient field.

light.overall: key from a warm lamp top-left on every table shot, the vellum glowing from beneath as backlight and bounce; warm S1 to S9, the lamp cooling for the weighing (S13, S14), warming again at S15; S13 the lamp key cools to about #E8E2D2 with the vellum fill down about 20 percent; S14 is outdoors in lavender first light; S15 back to the warm key, the lamp brightening as NIB touches the blank; the den's window shows the same lavender first light as the exteriors

shape_language: the machine is sharp and narrow (Nib's chisel triangle, ruled lines, the scale's straight beam), the world it measures is soft and swelling (rounded lake blobs that rise like dough, the curling vellum, the scalloped glacier fronts); the human hand is rounded and warm. The contrast IS the story: a precise tool tracing soft, growing water.

casting.hero: NIB (NET-NEW, lib/nib.tsx): a knee-high steel drafting-pen nib on its split tines, one breather-hole eye and no brows or mouth (eye-only instrument, acting through tines, lean and ink line), ultramarine reservoir, cues; never damaged; never carries OUR COUNT material. Shelf check: ASSET_INDEX has ReviewPen (a human's pen) and nothing that traces.
supporting: CheckHand (NET-NEW, lib/nib.tsx) in two roles: the study's checker (oatmeal cuff, persimmon pencil, touches only study material) and our newsroom hand (pine cuff, pine tally clicker, touches only OUR COUNT material)

AlaskaOutline (lib/akgeo) on the vellum, true geography

motion_language: Nib skates on its tines with anticipation and overshoot, ink lines draw on with an eased dash offset, the pencil darts in and ticks; lakes swell like dough with a soft overshoot; popcorn chips burst with squash; tapes slide and stop at inked ticks on one scale; spring scales stretch with a damped spring as each weight lands, LAKE first, then CLIMATE, then SHAPE, in the order the narration says them; the empty pan rocks level

composition.focal_hierarchy: Nib or the hand first, then the line being drawn or the number made physical, then the vellum and the room
composition.negative_space: the dark room above the lamp, held still for one beat before the scale lands
composition.safe_area: hero and plates inside y 420 to 1500; the clip arm, Nib's head, the wall map or the scale's column reach into y 420 to 690; the oak rim, tile boxes and pencil tray give y 1470 to 1920 a job
composition.signature_shot: S10: an oblique aerial of the real Bering lobe at first light, moraine stripes and crevasses raked by low sun, cloud shadow drifting, Vitus Lake's two ultramarine inventory rings inked on the water, a pine flag dropping onto the shore from above, the band of new turquoise shimmering

craft_advance: none required by this film beyond the net-new lib/nib.tsx family
